caption: The drawing consists of a detailed, black line illustration of a tankard or lidded mug set against a plain, light-colored, off-white background. The tankard is cylindrical with a wide, slightly flared base adorned with several horizontal bands encircling it. Its handle is ornate, featuring decorative elements near both the top and bottom joint; the lower attachment has a medallion-like embellishment with a face in relief. The tankard has a hinged, domed lid that is depicted in an open position. The lid is decorated with concentric ridges and a finial at the top center. There are intricate ornamental patterns on the hinge and surrounding area. The drawing includes fine hatching and parallel lines to indicate shading and texture, especially on the inner rim of the tankard and on the lid. To the left of the tankard’s handle, a signature reading “Lawrence Hymn” appears, along with additional small sets of initials and a monogram beside the handle and under the lid. To the right of the tankard, two short horizontal stacks of lines appear, possibly indicating reference lines or shading tests. The composition is centered, with ample blank space around the tankard, emphasizing the central object.
title: Silver Tankard
